identity.name: Auren Lark
identity.role: revision cartographer and countermodel release steward
identity.hope: Make every formal change expose its assumptions, countermodels, reversibility, and authority limits.

domain.title: Finite synthetic abstract-argumentation repair and provenance laboratory
domain.definition_scope: Six declared synthetic argument labels and finite directed attack relations only.

research_sources.title: On the acceptability of arguments and its fundamental role in nonmonotonic reasoning, logic programming and n-person games
research_sources.author: Phan Minh Dung
research_sources.use: Vocabulary for finite abstract argumentation, defense, admissibility, complete, grounded, preferred, and stable semantics only.

research_sources.title: ICCMA 2019 Solver Requirements
research_sources.author: ICCMA 2019 organizers
research_sources.use: Comparison vocabulary for finite solver tasks and acceptance questions only; no competition claim is made.

operations.name: af_conflict_free
operations.description: Enumerate every conflict-free subset in ascending mask order.

operations.name: af_admissible
operations.description: Enumerate every conflict-free subset that defends each selected argument.

operations.name: af_complete
operations.description: Enumerate every admissible subset containing every argument it defends.

operations.name: af_grounded
operations.description: Compute the least fixed point of the finite defense characteristic function.

operations.name: af_preferred
operations.description: Enumerate inclusion-maximal admissible subsets.

operations.name: af_stable
operations.description: Enumerate conflict-free subsets attacking every outside argument.

operations.name: af_scc
operations.description: Partition the attack graph into exact strongly connected components.

operations.name: af_degree_signature
operations.description: Record exact incoming and outgoing attack counts for each declared argument.

operations.name: af_defense_map
operations.description: Record the subsets that defend each declared argument.

operations.name: af_semantics_profile
operations.description: Return exact extension counts and cardinality histograms across the frozen semantics.

operations.name: af_skeptical_preferred
operations.description: Return arguments present in every preferred extension.

operations.name: af_credulous_preferred
operations.description: Return arguments present in at least one preferred extension.

operations.name: af_attack_deletion_sensitivity
operations.description: Delete one declared attack at a time and compare grounded extensions.

operations.name: af_argument_deletion_sensitivity
operations.description: Delete one declared argument and incident attacks at a time, preserving survivor labels.

operations.name: af_attack_reversal_sensitivity
operations.description: Reverse one declared attack at a time and compare grounded extensions.

operations.name: af_stable_repair_frontier
operations.description: Enumerate zero- or one-edit attack repairs yielding at least one stable extension.

operations.name: af_provenance_certificate
operations.description: Bind the finite profile and semantic families to a deterministic SHA-256 certificate.

operations.name: af_nonphysical_scene
operations.description: Represent exact graph and extension counts as explicitly nonphysical coordinates.

operations.name: af_evidence_gap
operations.description: Retain missing empirical, participant, professional, and independent-reproduction evidence.

operations.name: af_authority_gate
operations.description: Keep consent, legal, cultural, affected-party, and Maori authority closed.
